prompts.shots: Create a polished photographic teaching comparison plate for a Vietnamese beginner filmmaking workshop. Same adult Vietnamese woman with short black bob, mustard yellow raincoat, navy trousers, small red shoulder bag, standing in a quiet old Vietnamese street with a teal wooden door and a bicycle. Natural realistic photography, no sci-fi, no text, no labels, no arrows, no watermark. All panels equal size with thin white gutters. Landscape plate with FOUR panels in a 2x2 grid. Top-left extreme wide: woman small, entire street dominates. Top-right wide: full body from head to feet and doorway context. Bottom-left medium: clearly waist to head. Bottom-right close-up: head and shoulders, expressive face. Same woman and costume and soft daylight in all panels. Strong unmistakable framing differences. Overall 3:2 landscape.
prompts.lens: Create a polished photographic teaching comparison plate for a Vietnamese beginner filmmaking workshop. Same adult Vietnamese woman with short black bob, mustard yellow raincoat, navy trousers, small red shoulder bag, standing in a quiet old Vietnamese street with a teal wooden door and a bicycle. Natural realistic photography, no sci-fi, no text, no labels, no arrows, no watermark. All panels equal size with thin white gutters. Landscape triptych THREE vertical panels side by side, each portrait with woman's head and torso SAME SIZE. Left: wide-angle 24mm look, camera close to woman, pronounced foreground-to-background distance, much smaller distant door and bicycle. Middle: normal 50mm look, camera farther back, balanced perspective. Right: 85mm portrait look, camera farthest back, background door and bicycle appear larger relative to woman, shallower depth of field. Same calm expression, soft daylight and pose. Demonstrate camera-distance-plus-lens choices, not just zoom crop. Overall 3:2 landscape.
